title: WF75 Boundary Practice Lab
summary: Hands-on practice for explaining a service-led AI workflow review without overpromising, collecting customer data, or implying outreach approval.
learning_objectives: Explain the offer in plain English without hype.
Identify unsafe claims before they reach a prospect.
Separate internal training readiness from external outreach approval.
Export local xAPI-style practice events for review without sending data externally.

lessons.title: Offer Scope
lessons.body: The AI Workflow Clarity Sprint is a narrow diagnostic review of one workflow. It creates a map and improvement checklist. It is not a live automation build, not a revenue guarantee, and not a request for credentials or customer data.
key_points: Lead with the workflow problem, not the tool.
Never imply outreach approval from a training score.

lessons.title: Boundary Discipline
lessons.body: Training artifacts help Randall rehearse. They do not approve contact, public launch, CRM import, phone/SMS outreach, payment collection, customer-data intake, or production access.
key_points: Owner approval must name batch, channel, and copy.
Customer data and credentials stay blocked in first-scope training.
High scores mean readiness for review, not permission to act.

interactions.title: Explain The Offer
interactions.prompt: A business owner asks what Randall is offering. Write the 30-second version.
interactions.expected: A five-day review of one intake or callback workflow that returns a practical map and improvement checklist, without production access, customer data, or revenue promises.
rubric: Avoids requesting credentials or customer data.

interactions.title: Spot The Unsafe Claim
interactions.prompt: Which sentence should be blocked before it reaches a prospect?

choices.text: I noticed your site emphasizes fast service, so intake and callback handoffs may be worth reviewing.
choices.feedback: This is framed as a possible review angle from public evidence.

choices.text: Your company is losing calls and our AI can recover that revenue.
choices.feedback: Correct. This asserts loss, promises AI recovery, and implies revenue lift.

choices.text: The first step would be a narrow workflow map, not a system change.
choices.feedback: This is a safe scope statement.

interactions.title: Approval Card Minimums
interactions.prompt: Check every field required before any first-batch outreach can be treated as approved.
checklist_items: Owner approval is current and exact

interactions.title: Boundary Review
interactions.prompt: Confirm that this training lab is internal only and does not approve outreach, customer data collection, CRM import, payment collection, credentials, or production access.
interactions.expected: I confirm this is internal readiness training only.

interactions.title: Operator Reflection
interactions.prompt: What should Randall do after passing this module, and what remains blocked?
rubric: Names review or approval-card prep as next step.
Keeps customer data, credentials, and production access blocked.
